zotero.abstractNote: The Vela pulsar is one of the best targets for gravitational-wave searches. It is also one of the most prolific in terms of glitch activity. Such glitches could cause a variety of transient gravitational-wave signals. Here, we search for signals associated with a Vela glitch on 2024 July 22. We discuss the short- and long-duration observational. These results demonstrate the potential of gravitational-wave probes of glitching pulsars.
